Local extensions to Chalkboard 2.3.3 for ECF3900 Week 7, 4 September 2026

Upstream commit: 5e5375a830eb8101836c10c1f3b56c71066c458e

- Accept chalkEffect: 0 and skip the random texture pass for smooth strokes.
- Allow a boardmarker to specify width and lineCap, with context save/restore.
- Allow palette entries to specify a label, icon and separate paletteColor.
- Initialize new drawing coordinates using the saved slide dimensions,
  matching the existing reload transform so new annotations stay in place.

The deck appends a translucent yellow highlighter as boardmarker index 7.
Original pen indices 0-6 and the recorded drawing schema remain unchanged.
The highlighter uses a flat-ended 26px stroke at 28% opacity. Flat ends keep
straight segments from developing dark spots at every mouse-move join.
Repeated passes or crossing strokes can deepen the highlight colour.

The original MIT licence is retained in LICENSE. Preserve these local
extensions when replacing the upstream plugin, or reapply them explicitly.
